headline: Security Forces Intensify Operations Following Kulgam Terror Attack
seoTitle: Security Personnel Injured In Kulgam Attack
metaDescription: Security forces continue operations in Kulgam following an attack on Central Reserve Police Force personnel, as authorities investigate terrorist funding.
aiSummaryBullets: Security operations are ongoing in Kulgam following a November ambush that left three Central Reserve Police Force personnel wounded.
Intelligence reports indicate 65 foreign terrorists are currently active in Kashmir, with many linked to Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammed.
Authorities are moving to seize properties of suspected terrorists discovered attempting to sell land to generate funds for militant activities.
aiContextParagraph: On November 11, 2026, a terror attack in Kulgam, South Kashmir, resulted in injuries to three members of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) after militants on a motorcycle opened fire on a security patrol. In the aftermath, security forces launched extensive search and counter-terror operations in the region. Recent intelligence reports suggest there are approximately 65 foreign terrorists operating within Kashmir, with 55 of those affiliated with groups such as Jaish-e-Mohammed and Lashkar-e-Taiba. Meanwhile, investigations into terror financing have led authorities to begin sealing properties owned by militants who were reportedly attempting to sell ancestral land through associates and family members to sustain their activities. Officials maintain that while local terrorist presence in the region has been largely suppressed, the ongoing security strategy remains focused on addressing the presence of foreign fighters.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the sustained security crackdown in Kulgam following the attack on CRPF personnel and ongoing reports regarding foreign terrorist activity in Kashmir.
